text:
Eve Chen: Quick check  — multiple spots in the API ref still show the single-string embeddings payload ("input": "..."). Could we normalize to the batched shape ("inputs": [...]) and add a compatibility note?
Raj Patel: Agreed. Which pages are hit?
Eve Chen: Found in openapi/embeddings.yml, the quickstart curl, and snippets/python/embeds_quickstart.py. A community user filed a bug about confused billing/latency when sending one-off strings as arrays.
Marta Ruiz: Our runtime accepts both but we should present the array as canonical. Proposal: update examples to use "inputs": [..], add a short callout: "Compatibility: single-string "input" accepted historically but examples now prefer "inputs" array." Mark the old shape as "compatibility-only" in docs.
ci-bot: Lint failure on PR branch: openapi example.request.body type mismatch (example is object; schema expects array).
Raj Patel: I'll update the openapi example and the curl snippet. New example body: {"model":"rwd-embed-1","inputs":["alpha","beta"]}.
Eve Chen: Please also update python snippet to: from redwood import Client
client = Client()
resp = client.embeddings.create(model="rwd-embed-1", inputs=["a","b"])
print(resp.data)
 and add a one-line migration note under Embeddings -> Request shape.
Marta Ruiz: I'll add a changelog one-liner linking to the migration note and schedule a sweep for JS/Go snippets after the merge.
docs-bot: Reminder: Deploy preview will fail until OpenAPI examples match schema.
Raj Patel: Pushed fixes to branch and adjusted the examples generator test to accept the new array example. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/920/files
ci-bot: CI queued for PR #920.
Eve Chen: Thanks  once CI green, merge and I'll file a tiny follow-up to replace one lingering JS example that still used "input". If support traffic spikes, we'll add an FAQ entry.
